APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

12 oz can or bottle sleeve

Beach Parties ↗

A rubber sleeve that hugs the can or bottle: Full print hides the can, so the branding is yours.

Tailgate & Car Parties ↗

One hand for the can, one for the food, no slipping.

Outdoor Bars ↗

Served over a can so the bar top stays dry.

Confirm for your project

Check the venue's no-glass rule, wind and sand exposure, and how it gets washed；venue container rules, pour size and how it travels in the car；service speed, stacking storage and lighting after dark.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
